title: Compare supplied ranges with their estimates
description: Each row supplies its bounds. The renderer preserves those values through inspection and export.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
format: rmd/1
---

## Delivery ranges overlap across routes

These illustrative records provide a lower bound, upper bound and optional estimate. The chart does not calculate a confidence level or infer a distribution.

```chart
type: interval
title: The east route has the widest supplied range
subtitle: Authored bounds in days; dots show supplied estimates
data:
  inline:
    - route: North
      lower: 2
      upper: 5
      estimate: 3.5
      note: Planned estimate
    - route: South
      lower: 3
      upper: 7
      estimate: 4.8
      note: Planned estimate
    - route: East
      lower: 1
      upper: 9
      estimate: null
      note: No estimate supplied
encoding: {x: route, lower: lower, upper: upper, y: estimate}
axes:
  x: {label: Route}
  y: {label: Estimate, unit: days}
style: {orientation: horizontal}
```

*Source: Illustrative authored values. Bounds carry only the meaning supplied by the author.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to inspect exact bounds. Table and CSV retain the original rows, including the missing estimate.
